title: One exhausted account never stops the pipeline while another account can work
description: Runs the agent registry suite against a real control plane: worker, reviewer, producer and master all configured on one exhausted account launch on a second usable account with no registry change, the failover recorded in registry history, and the first account leads again once its usage window resets. With both accounts serving a role, a second account whose usage window resets within 60 minutes with at least 30% unused is selected first, and the selection reason names its reset.

steps.name: single account exhaustion keeps every role running, and expiring quota on a second account is spent first
